description: Ozon Intelligence SR: ozon/category Search API.

categoryId.description: Ozon category ID, obtained from the Ozon category document or other SR Ozon tools; multi-level categories are connected with `_`.

fulfillment.description: Delivery method: `FBO`, `FBS`, `RFBS`, `FBP`, `OZON`; do not query all, it must be a single string instead of an array.

memberId.description: Member ID; a member's unique identifier, the data belongs to this member, the maximum number is 1000.

orders.description: Sorting rule, the element is `{field, direction}`; `direction` takes `DESC` or `ASC`. Commonly used fields: `sales`, `price`, `revenue`, `reviewRating`.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of items per page is 20. If exceeded, `errcode 1002` will be returned.
